ArrowLoop 2.9.3 lets the Root target see every app's folder, keeps wide lists inside their card, opens the time picker in front of the page and keeps pairing working while another member reconnects.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The Root target lists every app's folder under /data/data.** su kept the Root target inside ArrowLoop's own view of the phone, where /data/data holds only ArrowLoop's folder and a few others, while file managers see them all. The Root target now reads the phone the way root sees it, so listing and copying from those folders works. Thanks to @AliNouhpisheh for the report ([#276](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/276)).
- **Wide lists stay inside their card.** In a narrower window the columns of History and of a job's runs and files ran past the card's right edge. They scroll sideways inside the card now, and State, Run time, the figures and When are narrower, so more fits before it scrolls. On a small tablet the phone stacks a row's cells when its columns would not fit. Column widths you set yourself stay as they are. Thanks to @danpeig for the report ([#284](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/284)).
- **The time picker opens in front of the cards below it.** For Every day and Weekdays, the hour and minute lists opened behind the next card, such as Transfer in Settings › Sync. The job editor and the automatic backup use the same picker and are fixed too. Thanks to @ckoul for the report ([#283](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/283)).
- **Pairing holds up while another member reconnects.** Opening another app in the fortress, reading its status, or running or saving a job on another instance failed if that member had just reconnected, as it does right after a join or a rename. ArrowLoop now waits a moment for the member, also with a change such as Run now, and that change reaches the other side once, even when its answer gets lost on the way. A renamed instance no longer shows as gone for a few seconds.
- **The phone's lists and job buttons on a tablet.** Beside the side bar, the column heads of the run list stood a little left of their columns, and the (i) on Pause covered the end of the word. The heads stand over their columns again, and the word stays clear of the (i).
